Image individual hybrid particles

02
characterization

Measure the width from bead surface to the ring boundary

L is CdS dispersion-layer width within the host; small L ring boundary is hard to establish. Absorbance-derived early L is an author-model estimate, not a direct image measurement.

precision limit
4 um · L below this value was not measured precisely; not an instrumental resolution specificationreported
